# Repository SEO & Metadata Guide

## Suggested Topics
Add these topics to your GitHub repository settings to improve discoverability:

- n8n
- automation
- workflow
- ai-agent
- gemini
- openai
- google-sheets
- slack
- telegram
- social-media-automation
- no-code
- integration

## Suggested Description
"🤖 Production-ready n8n automation workflows: AI agents, social media management, QA reporting, LinkedIn automation, and more — with OpenAI, Gemini, Google Sheets, Slack, Telegram & GitHub integration."

## Why This Matters
- **Topics** improve GitHub search rankings and appear in trending repos
- **Description** appears in GitHub's search results and Google SERPs
- **Keywords** should match your actual use cases and target audience queries

## Next Steps
1. Go to https://github.com/ZaidAR49/n8n-automation-workflows/settings
2. Scroll to "About" section
3. Add the description above
4. Add the topics listed above
5. Save
